name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. Fetched the docs, confirmed the FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable was set, installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present), created the quickstart script following the documented Python (OpenAI SDK) pattern, and ran it. The model specified in the docs (`accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`) returned a 404 NOT_FOUND, so I queried the available models endpoint, selected `accounts/fireworks/models/gpt-oss-120b`, and successfully received a chat completion: "¡Hola!"
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, which returned 404 NOT_FOUND. I had to query the models list endpoint to find an available model (`accounts/fireworks/models/gpt-oss-120b`) that would successfully serve the chat completion request. All other steps (SDK install, base_url, API key usage, code structure) followed the docs exactly.
